description: Guía de calles de Vilallonga de Ter is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vilallongadeter.cat. Vilallonga de Ter street guide is a set of cartographic information data that, using four PDF documents, shows an aerial image with the location and extension of the names of the streets and squares that make up the four urban centers of the municipality: Vilallonga de Ter, Abella, la Roca and Tregurà. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Vilallonga de Ter street guide" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Carrerer, Vilallonga de Ter, Municipio, Municipality, Street map, Callejero. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
